data.body: AC amendment: Before writing integration code in runner.py, read the S-A story (4425-a483-9cfe-466a) to confirm S-A's exact schema-fail signal mechanism (exit code routing vs env var vs return value). If S-A is not yet implemented, use stub env var DSO_CI_SCHEMA_FAIL_SIGNAL=1 with a TODO(S-A) comment. Use the same config resolution pattern as _read_tier_model() in runner.py: subprocess call to read-config.sh for review.schema_correction_max_attempts, defaulting to 1 when empty/absent (not a Python _read_config helper — that function does not exist in runner.py).
